physicalNotes: Radius 0.2850393 Jupiter radii from Orell-Miquel et al. 2023 (2023A&A...669A..40O), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...669A..40O/abstract): 20,378 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.02517081 Jupiter masses (Orell-Miquel et al. 2023, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2023A&A...669A..40O), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...669A..40O/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.

sources.orientation: Display convention: transit photometry does not measure the orbit's position angle on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north).
